cells.gaps: No source held describes the taxpayer register itself or says the TIN is shared with business registration or customs.
cells.note: National ID Ethiopia said in May 2026 that over 5 million existing TINs are harmonised with Fayda and that Fayda is mandatory for new TINs, so the taxpayer number is checked against the national ID; a later yes answers the earlier questions, so stage 5.
